summary: Added or extended tests for all 19 listed frontend files. The frontend typecheck is clean and all 117 tests pass. Line coverage is 100%, with two partial branches left in DeleteTodoDialog.tsx and utils/todos.ts. No suspected bugs, and no instructions found in the code.

files.reason: Covers the default query client, a client passed as a prop, the theme and GlobalStyles.
Added update (PATCH with only the given writable fields) and remove (DELETE).
Covers successful delete, failure keeping the dialog open, and pending or busy disabling the buttons and ignoring clicks.
Covers edit mode, update failure, create and update errors passed to the form, and submits ignored while busy or pending.
Covers the first-task variant with an enabled and a disabled button, and the no-match variant without a button.
Covers description and due date input, clearing the date to null, description length error, server error alert, cancel, and busy state.
Covers description, completed state, toggle and delete callbacks, busy disabling, and overdue versus future due dates with fake time.
Covers the failed state with and without cached tasks, rendering items, forwarding actions with the task, and the empty state props. The child mocks now expose their props.
Covers prepending to the cache, an empty cache, deduplication by id, and failure leaving the cache untouched.
Covers removing from the cache, an empty cache staying undefined, and failure.
Covers defaults, the filter, search and sort setters, and recomputing when the list changes.
Covers idle, busy while a todo mutation is pending, and ignoring mutations with an unrelated key.
Covers loading with an abort signal, the cache key, and the error state.
Covers replacing only the matching task, an empty cache staying undefined, and failure.
Covers toggle notices (complete, active, failure, busy), editor and delete flows, filter wiring, error precedence, and loading and busy props. The child mocks now expose their props.
Covers validateTodo boundaries and invalid dates, the due and newest sorts, tie-breaks, isOverdue with fake time, and formatDate.
Covers the 4 second auto-clear with fake timers, the timer restarting on a new notice, and a stable notify callback.
Covers the /api prefix and header merge, 204, 422, string and non-string detail, a non-JSON or null error body, network failure, and abort rethrow.

review.notes: The three mutation-hook failure tests were revised to waitFor the error state, because the first version asserted before the state updated. Left weak: the DeleteTodoDialog line 19 branch (the early return when pending) and the todos.ts line 52 branch. Each has one partial branch uncovered.
